text:
The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how this relates to your analogy: Imagine Mount Olympus as the central, most powerful server in that vast library. Just as the gods reside at the peak, overseeing everything below, the most authoritative and well-indexed websites (like major news outlets or academic institutions) sit at the "top" of search results. When you use a search engine, you are essentially asking the library's index to point you toward the highest, most relevant "books" (websites) and "pages" (web pages) that contain the information you need, much like a librarian guiding you to the best resources in the collection.
